chunks: And it was narrated from Abū ʿAbdِ اللَّهِ al-Khurāsānī, from Abū Jaʿfar al-Thānī عليه السلام, who said:

I said to him: I performed hajj while I was a dissenter, and I have performed this hajj of mine, and Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has bestowed upon me the knowledge of you. And I came to know that what I had been upon was false. So what do you think regarding my hajj?
He عليه السلام said: “Make this the Hajj of Islam, and that one supererogatory.”

key_terms.بِمَعْرِفَتِكُمْ: with recognition and knowledge of you, meaning the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.حَجَّةَ الْإِسْلَامِ: the obligatory hajj that fulfills the fundamental Islamic duty
key_terms.مُخَالِفٌ: one who was opposed in belief and not upon the correct doctrine

ai.seo_question: If someone performed hajj before accepting the truth of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام, does that hajj count as Hajj al-Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling for someone who had performed hajj before attaining correct recognition of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام and then performed hajj again after guidance. Imam Abū Jaʿfar al-Thānī عليه السلام instructs that the later hajj is counted as the obligatory Hajj of Islam, while the earlier one is treated as a voluntary hajj.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2884 - It was narrated from Abu Abdullah al-Khurasani, from Abu Ja'far al-Thani, Imam Muhammad al-Jawad (as), who said:

I said to him: "I performed Hajj while I was a dissenter, and now I have performed this Hajj after Allah (swt), the Exalted, has blessed me with the knowledge of you (Ahlulbayt). I have come to know that what I was upon was false. What is your view of my previous Hajj?"
Imam (as) said: "Make this [current] Hajj the Hajj of Islam, and consider the previous one as a supererogatory (nafl) Hajj."
